reviews.comment: Dr. Wang is a great professor. He cares about the students and making sure that we understand the content. Very good lecturer even though the material is fairly difficult. He is very lenient about HW deadlines and is clear about the exam criteria. Highly recommend taking a class with him at some point.

Dr. Wang is literally a genius. The class covers some pretty difficult material and he just whiteboards everything without any notes lol. He is super nice and lenient about HW deadlines and the exams are literally just the HW questions. The class was pretty easy and informative and I felt like he was a great lecturer.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I actually took his class a year ago, but wanted to say that he is one the most genuine and kindest professors I have ever had. He really spends time making sure students truly understand the material and what is being asked in the homework, as he just wants students to learn and is not afraid to help them, no matter how confusing things are.

Professor is a very kind guy. Very forgiving. You can e-mail him if you miss a lecture in advance, get extensions on homework, yada yada. He's pretty funny too, in his own way. I think that he's a gem of a professor and I would participate in class, even if it gets confusing. Laid back class, material is semi-difficult. That's it. Good guy.

Wenping is one of my favorite professors at TAMU.  His lectures were interesting and insightful; it's clear that he is both knowledgeable and passionate about the material.  In addition, he gives tons of extensions to ensure that everyone can complete the assignments/projects.  The homeworks are the perfect difficulty as well.

Dr. Wang is an amazing lecturer. The material is difficult, but he clearly explains each topic. We were only graded on 5 homework assignments (consisting of written and programming questions) and then the final. Attend lectures regularly, pay attention/take notes, and you will be fine.
